host.physical_host: Vercel cloud sandbox: physical host identity opaque; owner explicitly accepts guest-only continuity under the cloud amendment.
host.cpu_reservation: Eight exposed vCPUs; six Go processors; guest affinity fixed. Physical pinning, SMT placement and tenant sharing unavailable and explicitly owner-accepted.
host.isolation_evidence: Owner accepts the exact disclosed cloud-sandbox amendment; proposal SHA256=f5c0adb561870354852292ebac2fbbfb19567e14e7dfcc1cb8ad67c838ed0562. Unrelated builds/tests finish before timing; stable /conductor/workload cgroup; no physical exclusivity claimed.
host.guest_image: Existing Amazon Linux 2023 Vercel sandbox; owner accepts current guest image bound by captured os-release, kernel, machine and boot identity.
